title: Veiled Lady of the Falls
description: A dark-skinned woman with long flowing black hair stands in the foreground wearing an ornate black veil and dress that drips with water. She holds a decorated handheld mirror in her right hand while looking down, set against a towering gothic cathedral interior with cascading waterfalls and dramatic beams of light.
prompt: A dark-skinned woman with intricate long black hair stands solemnly in a decaying gothic cathedral, wearing a dripping ornate black veil and dress. She holds an ornate handheld mirror with red and green details, gazing downward. Massive waterfalls cascade through the broken cathedral arches behind her as dramatic beams of light cut through the darkness, purple glowing particles float in the air, moody cinematic lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere
